discussion: A cyber security strategy sets out an organisation’s guiding principles, objectives and priorities for cyber security, typically over a three to five year period. In addition, a cyber security strategy may also cover an organisation’s threat environment, cyber security initiatives or investments the organisation plans to make as part of its cyber security program. Without a cyber security strategy, an organisation risks failing to adequately plan for and manage security and business risks within their organisation.
section_path: Development and maintenance of security documentation
title: A cyber security strategy is developed, implemented and maintained.
